g.text: A causal controller repair reduces instability

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Rev J simulation • 45 frozen paired cases • same Hall and contact sensors • common clean target

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Each class: 15 cases = 5 synthetic writers × 3 frequencies. Error and power bars are case means; intervals are descriptive 95% writer-cluster bootstraps.

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Ink rates pool 112.500 s scored time: 64.7685 s required ink and 47.7315 s required lift. Each note follows 3 s rest, then 2.5 s writing.

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Proposed mechanics and sensor parameters remain unmeasured. This is a stability repair, with no demonstrated word-readability, patient or thermal-safety benefit.
